Name: Announcer
Dialog: From the PFT Studios in still moderately charming and majestic downtown Danville, it's—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, we know the drill. We've hosted before. (pointing to Major Monogram) He's good, I'm evil, blah blah blah.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I, for one, am excited to be here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm all tingly! I've actually got butterflies in my sto—

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Let me finish my introduction! Welcome to Phineas and Ferb's Musical Cliptastic Countdown Hosted by...Kelly Osbourne! (Timpani drum plays as Doof and Monogram get questionable looks on their faces.) And now, here's our host

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Hi, everybody! What'cha doin'? I have always wanted to say that. I am so excited to be here. I promise you guys, this is gonna be a rockin' show full of surprises. And anyone who knows anything about me, they know that I absolutely LOVE Phineas and Ferb! And being a singer myself, I love love LOVE the songs.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wai-wai-wai-, w-what's goin' on here?! We are the hosts!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yeah, and, uh, aren't you a little too three-dimensional to host an animated show, young lady?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I am. But I'm doing it anyway, so just deal with it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But w-we have hosting contracts and everything!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Did you read your contract?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nobody reads them, they're like a hundred pages long and pages 2 through 99 are useless, like, like parsley on a dinner plate. Nobody eats it. Y'know, if they're gonna put stuff on your plate that y-you're not gonna eat, why not make it something useful, like a-like a keychain or, or gold doubloons.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Dude, why are you rambling on about parsley? You're bringing the entire energy of the show down! Maybe you guys can be my co-hosts!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Co-hosts? I don't like the sound of that. Sounds like a demotion.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Enough of you two. (to the audience) You guys ready? Let's get this party started!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: There were so many songs to pick from, I mean, just take a look at all of them.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wow, that is a lot of songs.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You guys voted and now we're gonna rock the top 10! Here's number 10!

Name: Guy
Dialog: Is this the Phineas and Ferb party?

Name: Guy #2
Dialog: Sure is.

Name: Guy #3
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb parties rule! (all cheering)

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not their party, it's my party! And it's not a party, it's an intimate get together. (Shattering) (Gasps) What was that? Put that down, pardon me, use a napkin! What is my science teacher doing here?

Name: Teacher
Dialog: I never miss a Phineas and Ferb party!

Name: Candace
Dialog: First of all, it's not a party, but if it were a party, it would not be their party, it would be MY PARTY!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom! What? WHAT?! I'm sorry, I can't hear you over Candace's intimate get together!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not a party.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (groans) Demoted to co-host.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: I've been a co-host before, and I had a blast doing it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, goody gumdrops for you!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Don't worry, Kelly. I am totally down for being second banana.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, first of all, that's a little sad. But, second of all, technically, you would be third banana. It would go

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Nobody is a banana, because there are no bananas!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, we have no bananas!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Here's the song rolling in at number 9!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent. From the top of this building, everyone in the Tri-State Area should be able to hear us.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, why don't you sing one?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Larry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I ran out of rhymes, all right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Comes and takes Candace's microphone) Good job, Larry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Welcome home.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: This is going to be a fantastic countdown! Um, just one thing, you guys. We seriously have to do something about your... your fashion. It's just not working.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, really?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You look a bit, like, stiff and-and uniformy. Right, guys?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uniformy? Is that even a word?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, "uniformy." If you look it up, there's a picture of you.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You're one to talk.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: I mean that whole laboratory look was never in, I mean, even if you are an "evil scientist". You should try a cape.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A cape? Where am I gonna get a cape at this hour?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You could try a Nehru jacket.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Well, go and get changed then.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (leaving with Monogram) If I could get a Nehru jacket, I could get a cape.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (shakes head) Men. While my co-hosts go backstage and bring their fashions into this century, here's song 8.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Okay, let's keep rocking and get rollin—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Wa-wa-wait for us!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yeah, hold the boat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mind you, this does not mean in any way, shape, or hair color, that I am your co-host. I-I'm just sayin'.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Wow! Now I know what I would look like if I had middle-aged male clones.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I can't believe I let myself get talked into this. It's embarrassing and, if I'm being honest, a bit drafty.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, just go with it, Francis. (to Kelly) Hey, l-look at this! Strike a pose! Look, look, look, I'm vo—

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Vogueing?! I love vogueing! It's so '90's!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I was a bit of a secret voguer myself.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Really?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It wasn't a secret.

Name: Kelly Osbounre
Dialog: You know what we should do then? Strike a pose.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vogue. Vogueing. That's it. Look it up, kids. That's what the internet is for.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That was fun! Great idea, Kelly.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Thank you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But, but, vogueing was my idea! I started to say "vogueing" and you just cut me off right before when I just got "vo" out. Y'know, I— (to Monogram) What did you think I was gonna say? Vociferous? What other words start with "vo"?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Give it a rest, Heinz. (to Kelly) He's always like this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it! That is it! You will rue the day that you demoted Heinz Doofenshmirtz to co-host! (he leaves)

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Hmm. You know what that means?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I think I do.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (sing-songy) More hosting for us!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: All right! Here's a little ditty I like to call "Song Number 7"!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On P.A) Ladies and Gentlemen, my sister, Candace Flynn!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The... uh... Wait a minute! It doesn't matter! I can't believe I was almost sucked into this!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Are you guys having as much fun as I am? (audience claps and cheers)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes! Now that I'm back in my old clothes, uniformy or not. I predict the Nehru jacket will make a comeback.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Mmm. Not gonna happen.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: But you know what is gonna happen? Song number 6!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So Phineas, what do you think of the City of Love?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wish it was the City of Airplane Parts.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, you're just too stressed. You should take a moment to relax and enjoy it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. That awning could be used as a sail. Or, you know, a parachute. Depending on how things go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder if they still have pieces of that hanging around? The rivets would come in handy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, Phineas...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look at that nifty little blow torch!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder if oil-based paint is combustible...as a rocket fuel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that reminds me, we might need helmets!

Name: Vendor
Dialog: Hey you!

Name: Vendor
Dialog: Stop letting my balloons go!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, little Miss Osbourne, (coming back onstage with an inator helmet on his head and a remote) prepare to say hello to your doom (Agent P appears on one of the rafters above the soundstage.) at the hands of—or, I guess in this case, in the head of—the man who is not your co-host! (Perry holds onto a rope with one hand and holds a mirror in the other.)

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Wow. That was close.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait. Was that Perry the Platypus? Great. They're probably letting him host the show.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Everyone welcome Perry! (massive applause and cheers) Oh my gosh, this day just keeps getting better and better! You know, I was hoping you'd stop by. Do you...Do you want to introduce the next song?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Let me translate for you guys. What I believe he just said was, "Swinging in at number 5 is..."

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Summer... It sounds dangerous, yet oddly compelling. What is it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is summer? Man, where do I begin?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, wait. Maybe we're going too fast.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: That last song just makes me wanna move and groove, but enough about me. Because I have a surprise for everyone. (applause and cheers) A friend of mine wanted to stop by and say hi, so please, put your hands together and give a warm welcome to Maia Mitchell!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Hi! I was watching from backstage and I could not wait to get out here! I love all the songs so far!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: I know, right? Aren't they fun?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Yeah, they're amazing! And, Kelly, you are doing an awesome job of hosting. Isn't she? (encourages applause and cheers) No, no, you're great! And, Major Monogram, I'm Maia. (shakes Monogram's hand)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Pleasure to meet you, young lady.

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: And Perry! I love you! You're my favorite, actually, because, we have something in common.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: We're both from Australia.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (gasp) Didn't even think of that. That's so cool!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: That is so cool. (giggles)

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Maia, why don't you introduce the next song?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: I was actually waiting for you to ask me to do that.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Check it out, it's number 4.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Do I know you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I'm you from another dimension.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well, that would explain the handsomeness.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Right back at'cha, big guy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Does that mean you and I are exactly alike?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I suppose so.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Blech, no, that's gross!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Me too!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But not the vending machine thing. That's gonna happen.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: It's in this pouch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ouch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I can't help but notice that your scar goes over your eyepatch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Yeah...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...Nothing...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, I meant Lorenzo.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh, that's right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What's that, are we doing a TV show together?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no. It just sort of sounded like that. Well, I mean, we could. We should!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Hmm, maybe we're not so much alike

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That can be your catchphrase! You're the grumpy one. (Pokes him) Eh?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: There are so many great songs!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: I know! What did you think about that last song, Perry?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: I have a...I have a confession.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: I might, uh, make Perry noises when no one's looking.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (gasps) You're kidding! Me, too!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: You do?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: All the time!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Make that three!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I just wanted to check to see if you— (freaks out) MAIA MITCHELL!!! I'm your biggest fan! Love your voice and your work!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Thank you so much. You're really sweet.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Hey, you know what? I've got an idea. Why don't we all make Perry noises together?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You ready?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (to Monogram) You ready? (Monogram cracks his knuckles) Okay.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (gasps) Nobody does it better than Perry.

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: I'll never get tired of that.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Me neither.

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Well, sadly, I have to go.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: No! Really?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Yeah, but thank you so much for having me.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Thank you so much for stopping by!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: (hugging Kelly) Of course, my pleasure. Heh!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Maia Mitchell, everyone!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: (waves) Bye!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Hey, I'll walk you out!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (chuckles) Looks like someone's got a schoolboy crush.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You think? Anyway, let's get back to the countdown.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Here's number 3.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Chuckles while sweating) Who's up for charades?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, what are you doing down here?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hi, Vanessa.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, what are you doing?

Name: Teen
Dialog: Oh I get it, platypus is a metaphor for whatever's keeping you down!

Name: Weird Teen
Dialog: My teacher is a panda!

Name: Weird Teen
Dialog: Wait! Oh wait, no, he's gone! Hey!

Name: Johnny
Dialog: (At Vanessa) Your dad's kinda cool.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You're my punk-rock boyfriend, you're not supposed to think my dad is cool! (She walks over to Doofenshmirtz) It only matters that I think he's cool. (Kisses him on the cheek)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: She thinks I'm cool!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You know what'd be really cool? To write a song so next year the song can be on the countdown!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, as a fellow musician, I heartily agree.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Oh, you're a musician?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, yes. From, uh, from time to time, I like to strum the (speaks the Hawaiian pronunciation) ukulele.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uhhhh, did I miss Maia Mitchell?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: I'm afraid so.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, bummer. Anyway, as a musician, not as a co-host, mind you, I'd like to get in on this little songwriting thing you're about to do.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: What do you play?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, several things, but my instrument of choice is the kazoo.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You rock the kaz?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I do.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Fine! Let's start with the lyrics then. Maybe we can do some sort of a round robin kinda thing and write a line, and the next person can rhyme it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, good idea. Ahem. Me first, me first. Uh, let's see. "When I wake up in the morning sun..."

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: "I realize you're the only one."

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Dude, really?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? What?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: There's no rhyme for the word "silver".

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: She's right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, look...eh...uh..."bilver" and, and, and there's (Kelly scoffs) What, what?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: What is a bilver?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's a...water moving thingy.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I believe what you're thinking of is a bilge pump.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is that better?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: See how I just rolled my eyes? (Audience laughs) Please roll clip number 2!

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right, I'm taking a verse.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Be my guest!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She's got it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: By Jove, I think she's got it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's what I'm talking about!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy! You came back early!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, I missed my girlfriend.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oooh! I like the sound of that!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Besides you forgot something in France.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I did? What?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: This.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Right, guys, before we roll our last clip, I have to know something. Do you have a favorite song on the countdown?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I'm, uh, I'm particularly partial to number three.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And I like number seven, that's my lucky number. (The background starts to ripple.) It all started when I was seven years old, back in Drusselstein—

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: W-W-Wait a minute. You're doing a flashback.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, yeah, it's kinda my thing. I do a lot of these (stammers)

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Um, I'm sorry we can't fit that in.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, what if I make it short?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: We still don't have time because...it's the moment we've all been waiting for! (audience claps and cheers) And I can't believe this, but you all picked my favorite song as the number one song! You guys have fabulous taste, I'm just saying. You guys ready? (audience claps and cheers) It's... Everything's Better with Perry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good morning, Perry! Now that's the way to wake up. (He hugs Perry) This is gonna be the best day ever.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Well, this has been the most amazing day! And to quote my favorites, Phineas and Ferb, "The best day ever!"

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I completely concur.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay, I've been reconsidering and I'm going to give in. I'm totally gonna be your co-host.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: That's great. But—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So what are my co-hosting duties? What's next on the old co-hosting train I jumped aboard? What do I do?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Say goodbye, Dr. D.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it? Goodbye, Dr. D.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Goodbye.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Thank you so much, everybody, that was so much fun. I'm gonna be singing these songs all day. See ya next time!
